# Velt Test Double

> A static test site for Superflow agent runs. Its pages hold known typos, layout faults and broken links on purpose.

## Test pages

- [Proofreader page](https://velt-test-double.vercel.app/agent-fixes/proofreader.html): four known typos
- [Links page](https://velt-test-double.vercel.app/agent-fixes/links.html): two broken links
- [Change detection assets page](https://velt-test-double.vercel.app/agent-fixes/cd-assets.html): a stylesheet and an image at stable URLs
